messages:
olivia_support: @michael_repro customer ACME reported tool invocation failing with 422 JSON schema error: additionalProperties 'promo_code'. They started after upgrading SDK to 1.2. Error in logs: 'toolcall schema validation failed: additionalProperties not allowed: promo_code'.

michael_repro: got it. can you paste repro payload?

olivia_support: pasted below (redacted customer ids):
```json
{
  "tool": "create_invoice",
  "args": {
    "customer_id": "cust_123",
    "items": [{"sku":"X1","qty":1}],
    "billing_profile": {"id":"bp_987"},
    "promo_code": "SPRING2026"
  }
}
```

sarah_engineering: thanks. schema for create_invoice explicitly sets additionalProperties: false on args/billing_profile and args top-level. 'promo_code' isn't allowed => validator rejects. Did we ever accept promo_code via older shim?

michael_repro: the customer says it worked before without change. I suspect an SDK started sending promo_code (we added convenience param) that previously was stripped by gateway. Repro steps: call /v1/tool/invoke with body above and API key for dev account. Returns 422 with body:
```json
{"error":"SchemaValidationError","message":"additionalProperties \"promo_code\" not allowed","path":"/args"}
```

sarah_engineering: looks like gateway strict mode flag was flipped to strict=true in 2026.03.10 deploy (infra-bot mentioned). @infra-bot was there a config change?

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-10T04:12Z applied: gateway-validator.strict_schema=true on prod. Rollout 100%.

leo_billing: if we allow promo_code it can affect billing calculation. Need product signoff. Also have to ensure promo lookup service is idempotent.

olivia_support: customer is blocked (billing flow can't complete). Asked for ETA. Can we provide temporary workaround: 1) remove promo_code from payload client-side or 2) use legacy endpoint /v1/tool/invoke? They can't change client quickly.

sarah_engineering: short-term patch: add compatibility layer in gateway to strip unknown top-level keys for toolcalls when header 'x-allow-compat' present. I can ship a canary today to support channel only. Need approval from leo_billing for billing risk.

leo_billing: OK for canary to limited customers (support-proxy) for 24h. Must log every promo_code and associate with invoice for review. No auto-apply.

michael_repro: I'll create repro docs and a curl example for support-canned response. Also will add note to SDK team to avoid adding extra args.

olivia_support: thanks — will tell customer we can enable compatibility flag for their org with canary within a few hours. Keep me posted.

sarah_engineering: created PR #3471 with gateway strip shim and telemetry. will request review and tag leo_billing. ETA 3h for canary if approved.

leo_billing: approved. please include audit log entries and a followup prod-safe plan.

olivia_support: updating customer now :thumbsup:
